newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-SCHALKE STARS GET CALL-UP FOR GERMANY.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SCHALKE STARS GET CALL-UP FOR GERMANY.

text.p: Germany coach Berti Vogts gave two members of Schalke's UEFA Cup-winning side their first international call-ups on Monday when he named his squad for next month's World Cup qualifier against Ukraine.

Goalkeeper Jens Lehmann -- the hero of last week's final against Internazionale of Milan for saving a penalty from Ivan Zamorano -- and defender Thomas Linke were both named in the 27-man squad for the group nine match in Kiev on June 7.
VfB Stuttgart midfielder Matthias Hagner was also nominated for the national squad for the first time.
A win for Germany in Kiev would allow them to take first place from Ukraine, who lead the group by two points but have played two games more than Vogts's side.
The Germany coach will reduce the squad after assessing injuries and form in the final Bundesliga matches of the season on Saturday.
Goalkeepers - Oliver Kahn (Bayern Munich), Stefan Klos (Borussia Dortmund), Andreas Koepke (Olympique Marseille), Jens Lehmann (Schalke).

Defenders - Markus Babbel (Bayern Munich), Thomas Helmer (Bayern Munich), Juergen Kohler (Borussia Dortmund), Thomas Linke (Schalke), Jens Nowotny (Bayer Leverkusen), Stefan Reuter (Borussia Dortmund), Matthias Sammer (Borussia Dortmund), Christian Woerns (Bayer Leverkusen).

Midfielders - Mario Basler (Bayern Munich), Dieter Eilts (Werder Bremen), Matthias Hagner (VfB Stuttgart), Joerg Heinrich (Borussia Dortmund), Jens Jeremies (1860 Munich), Andreas Moeller (Borussia Dortmund), Mehmet Scholl (Bayern Munich), Michael Tarnat (Karlsruhe), Dariusz Wosz (Bochum), Christian Ziege (Bayern Munich).
Forwards - Oliver Bierhoff (Udinese), Fredi Bobic (VfB Stuttgart), Sean Dundee (Karlsruhe), Ulf Kirsten (Bayer Leverkusen), Juergen Klinsmann (Bayern Munich).
